articles.summary: OMAHA, Neb.–(BUSINESS WIRE)–InfoWest Inc. (“InfoWest”), a majority owned subsidiary of Boston Omaha Corporation (NYSE:BOC) has completed the acquisition of substantially all of the assets of SunRiver Fiber Network from Cable Systems of Nevada (“Cable Systems”). The transaction includes all fiber internet assets along with the internet and VoIP subscriber agreements. The acquisition expands InfoWest’s current […]
articles.title: InfoWest, A Subsidiary of Boston Omaha Corporation (NYSE: BOC), Acquires Assets of SunRiver Fiber Network
